purpose: One explicit release decision per bench-spec vector. The house release gate (scripts/hooks/precommit_gate.py) refuses a version bump unless the committed gate result reports every required vector as PASS, never SKIPPED, and partial only where partial_allowed carries a written partial_reason. A vector marked required: false is not release evidence in either direction; its reason says why. This inventory records what a green gate covers today. It is not a claim that the not-required vectors are covered, and changing a decision changes the source fingerprint, so a result produced under an older inventory cannot authorize a release.
